# T5 evals — Soon bentos on 7 routes, /emergency live links, /assistant redirect

Test file: tests/components/t5-soon-pages.test.tsx. Harness: render each route's page (default export from src/app/(app)/<route>/page.tsx, awaited if async) with a signed-in real, non-demo account (demo flag false, no sample data). Soon tiles = elements with aria-disabled="true" and title "Coming soon". Label match = exact text content of the tile.

E1. /family labels. Test "family renders 3 soon tiles". Expect aria-disabled="true" tiles with labels: People and relations, Who is covered by what, Invite family. PASS: all 3 present, each tile aria-disabled="true"; soon-tile count = 3; existing owner card still rendered.

E2. /money labels. Test "money renders 6 soon tiles". Labels: Premiums this year, Tax you can save (80D), Receipts, Renewal reminders, Claims paid, Download 80D pack. PASS: all 6 present, each aria-disabled="true", count = 6.

E3. /cards labels. Test "cards renders 3 soon tiles". Labels: E-cards, Add to wallet, Share a card. PASS: all 3 present, aria-disabled="true", count = 3.

E4. /compare labels. Test "compare renders 3 soon tiles plus real rows". Labels: Plans in your cover band, Top-ups, Talk to an advisor. PASS: all 3 present, aria-disabled="true", count = 3; existing real compare rows still rendered.

E5. /desk labels. Test "desk renders 3 soon tiles". Labels: Open claims, Insurer conversations, Documents to sign. PASS: all 3 present, aria-disabled="true", count = 3.

E6. /stress-test labels. Test "stress-test renders 3 soon tiles plus bill input". Labels: Pick a procedure, Insurer pays vs you pay, With a top-up. PASS: all 3 present, aria-disabled="true", count = 3; existing bill input still rendered.

E7. /emergency live + soon. Test "emergency live links and soon tiles". Expect a[href="tel:112"], a[href="tel:108"], a[href="/hospitals"] each exactly 1 and NOT aria-disabled; soon labels: E-card for the desk, Blood availability, Share location with family. PASS: all 3 links present and enabled; 3 soon tiles, each aria-disabled="true"; none of the 3 live links inside a soon tile.

E8. /emergency static. Test "emergency has no animation". PASS: rendered DOM has no element with inline animation/transition style or class containing "motion|animate|fade|pulse"; `grep -nE "framer-motion|motion/react|animate|@keyframes" src/app/\(app\)/emergency/ src/components/soon/ -r` (emergency files only) returns 0 matches; links render with no signed-in-state gating (also render with empty/failed data fetch: links still present).

E9. Grid and no blank state. Test "every route has 3-col bento, no blank". For all 7 routes: container with the BentoGrid, cols=3 (data-cols="3" or equivalent class/style 3 columns), ≥1 child row of tiles; `queryByText(/Nothing here yet/i)` is null. Also `grep -rn "Nothing here yet" src/app/\(app\)/{family,money,cards,compare,desk,stress-test,emergency} src/components/soon` returns 0 matches. PASS: all 7 routes satisfy both.

E10. No sample data. Test "real account shows no sample names". For all 7 routes rendered as real account: document.body.textContent does not match /Meera|Rohan|Kabir|Mother|Father/. PASS: 0 matches on all 7.

E11. Assistant redirect + tokens. `grep -c 'redirect("/chat")' "src/app/(app)/assistant/page.tsx"` outputs 1 (file has no other rendered content). `git diff main -- src/styles/tokens.css` (locate with `git ls-files | grep tokens.css`): changed lines touch only --bento-gap and --tile-pad (`git diff -U0 -- <tokens.css> | grep -E '^[+-][^+-]' | grep -vE '\-\-(bento-gap|tile-pad)'` outputs nothing). PASS: both conditions hold.

E12. verify. `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build` — expect exit 0. PASS if exit 0 and t5-soon-pages.test.tsx ran with 0 failures.
